invariants.rationale: The method requires a non-null context to execute a commit action.
instantTime typically represents a commit instant and should be specified and non-empty.
A valid list of records to delete is required to perform deletePrepped.
If preppedRecords is provided, it usually should not be empty to perform delete operations.
The method immediately casts the context to HoodieJavaEngineContext, so this should hold to avoid a ClassCastException.
